title: A self-learning framework for adaptive free-form pipe routing in aeroengines
abstract: arXiv:2504.03669v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pipe routing is a highly complex, time-consuming, and no-deterministic polynomial-time hard (NP-hard) problem in aeroengine design. Despite extensive research efforts in optimizing constant-curvature pipe routing, the growing demand for free-form pipes poses new challenges. Dynamic design environments and fuzzy layout rules further impact the optimization performance and efficiency. To tackle these challenges, this study proposes a self-learning-based method (SLPR) for optimizing free-form pipe routing in aeroengines. The SLPR is based on the proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm and integrates a unified rule modeling framework for efficient obstacle detection and fuzzy rule modeling in continuous space. Additionally, a potential energy table is constructed to enable rapid queries of layout tendencies and interference. translated_title: 面向航空发动机自适应自由形态管路布线的自学习框架
translated_abstract: 管路布线是航空发动机设计中一个高度复杂、耗时且属于非确定性多项式时间困难（NP-hard）的问题。尽管在优化等曲率管路布线方面已有大量研究，但日益增长的对自由形态管路的需求带来了新的挑战。动态设计环境和模糊布局规则进一步影响了优化的性能和效率。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种基于自学习的方法（SLPR），用于优化航空发动机中的自由形态管路布线。SLPR基于近端策略优化（PPO）算法，并集成了一个统一的规则建模框架，可在连续空间中实现高效的障碍物检测和模糊规则建模。此外，构建了一个势能表，可实现对布局倾向和干涉情况的快速查询。SLPR中的智能体通过迭代细化管路布线并积累设计知识，从而不断提升布线质量。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于近端策略优化（PPO）算法的自学习管路布线方法（SLPR），通过统一的规则建模框架和势能表实现快速障碍检测与模糊规则建模，从而在动态设计环境下自适应地优化航空发动机的自由形态管路布线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SLPR, a self-learning pipe routing framework based on proximal policy optimization, which adaptively optimizes free-form pipe routing in aeroengines by integrating a unified rule modeling framework for efficient obstacle detection and fuzzy rule modeling with a potential energy table for rapid query of layout tendencies and interference.
